# Architecture overview

Architecture description alignment profile for ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022; no conformance assessment or certification

Scope: Observed generated distance, proper-warp uncloak, source-owned scalar angular state, angular snapshot/replay and formation wiring. Standalone core completion comes first; Original Blue hosting is deferred. Full world-feature, assurance, platform and production-quality gates remain open. Generated source stop integration now retains uncapped input velocity, with a custom maximum-velocity parameter and source collision preparation before Avian damping setup. The generated aligning-warp dispatch now delegates to the existing source goto thrust while the effect stamp remains negative. Generated spherical partition ownership now extends the existing bubble tracker, with source-defined parent/shared lifetime, master insertion and live GetBallBox queries. Complete/full acceptance remains open.

View `V-overview`; model kind: Context and requirements. Concerns: Q-behavior, Q-interfaces, Q-reproduce.

Latest Original Destiny is pinned independently of the Rust development branch. Prior Rust was preserved through a verified fast-forward. Source/file inventories and all 532 original cases remain visible; a complete feature denominator is not established. The current milestone is the complete standalone world engine. No complete typed host API, full state/effect denominator or production-ready acceptance is claimed; Original Blue integration remains planned.

| Component | Source | Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| C-python | [python/destiny/_facade.py](../../python/destiny/_facade.py) | Python objects, property bindings and native-call representations (observed) |
| C-abi | [src/ffi.rs](../../src/ffi.rs) | Opaque C runtime ownership, request envelopes and callback boundary (observed) |
| C-runtime | [src/runtime.rs](../../src/runtime.rs) | Owns Bevy App, stable ID/entity associations, lifecycle and API dispatch (observed) |
| C-generation | [verification/codegen/src/main.rs](../../verification/codegen/src/main.rs) | Genco source emission, Rust syntax comparison and span-preserving transformations (newly_chosen) |
| C-world-scope | [verification/migration/world_scope.json](../../verification/migration/world_scope.json) | Partial source-bound semantic classification and core features; unknowns block completion (partial_inventory) |
| C-acceptance | [verification/tools/update_migration.py](../../verification/tools/update_migration.py) | Single queue writer and separate core/full rejection reports; incomplete full inventory and assurance readers remain explicit (implemented_rejection_with_open_readers) |
| C-partition | [src/generated_partition.rs](../../src/generated_partition.rs) | Persistent box/primary/membership ownership in the existing Tracking resource, generated from typed source rules and shared numeric kernels. (newly_chosen) |

Relationships:

- `C-python` → `C-abi`: Python backend submits ABI calls.
- `C-abi` → `C-runtime`: dispatches into owned runtime.
- `C-acceptance` → `C-world-scope`: validates original digests/assertion coverage and routes core and adapter obligations without dropping unknowns.
- `C-runtime` → `C-partition`: Projects real ECS source fields into shared arithmetic and source-owned insertion/removal rules at command/tick/lifecycle boundaries.

Open obligations:

- Complete feature/configuration inventory and compiler extraction
- Remaining original fixture failures and missing Blue execution
- Kani/Verus production correspondence and all required proof obligations
- Original controller, collision, snapshot and private wire behavior
- Windows/macOS, full package matrix, complete notices/archive and real transport acceptance
- Complete standalone host API, field/effect ownership, core target matrix and production-quality receipt readers
- Dynamic angular orientation, collision-history correspondence, stop/warp and interacting controller fidelity
- Original Blue host integration is a later milestone; its world semantics remain core
- Complete source partition static/dynamic/OBB effects, native unordered-map order, object identity/lifetime and complete snapshot/history validation; newest KeyHash regression retained.
- Original master InDeadBubble interactive/keep-alive scheduling is not yet implemented in runtime; preserve all dependent evolution/proximity obligations.
- Moved-missile-only late contact append and per-body, reentrant DoCollision dispatch must precede following body publication; full pending-state/location/history correspondence remains required.
- Source old/new pose slots are mutable authoritative phase state: source AddBall initializes old_pos=new_pos-dt*new_vel only on creation and retains it on replacement; setters write both slots and Evolve swaps them. The current immutable motion plan cannot implement callback-time writes to later pending results. This is required core work before exact publication, not a host-only omission.
